classification.difficultyReason: Read the two marked coordinates, calculate their signed gradient, take the negative reciprocal, and combine it with the supplied y-intercept to form an equation.

content.prompt: What is the equation of the line perpendicular to the line shown and passes through $(0,-3)$?

spec.description: Rectangular unit grid from x = −6 to 6 and y = −4 to 5, double-ended axes, x labels −5 to 5, y labels −3 to 4, one numeric origin label, and a descending blue line with arrowheads and two marked points.
spec.mathematics: The marked points are (-3,2) and (2,-1). The supplied line is y = -3x/5 + 1/5.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied line and marked points are visible; the requested perpendicular line and its equation are answer content.
